# FG-REVIEW-0023

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_change_that_drops_a_table_is_a_failure_with_risk_stop` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この変更は、プログラムの破壊・DB の破壊・機密の流出のおそれがあるため、自動マージされません。チェック forge/risk の理由を確かめてください。
- en: This change may break the program, destroy database data or leak a secret, so it is not merged automatically. Read the reasons in the forge/risk check.
- id: Perubahan ini berpotensi merusak program, menghapus data basis data atau membocorkan rahasia, sehingga tidak digabung otomatis. Baca alasannya pada pemeriksaan forge/risk.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/risk` (M3 X7, plan 04 M-6 layer 1, ADR-0023 Amendment X7) found a deterministic rule of class `stop` in a merge request head's diff against the merge base with its target branch: an applied migration changed or removed, a destructive statement in a new migration (DROP TABLE / COLUMN / SCHEMA / DATABASE, TRUNCATE, DELETE or UPDATE without WHERE, a column type change or rename, a dropped constraint, a disabled trigger), a file that looks like a secret (a credential file by name, a private key or token pattern by content), a backup / restore / retention job changed, a rollback step in a deploy file, a mass deletion (500 lines and 30 % of the target's text lines, or 20 files and 30 % of its files), or a change too large to assess (more than 5000 files). The run concludes `failure`; it blocks a merge only where a protected branch requires `forge/risk` (a `failure` never satisfies a required check), and M4's auto-merge never merges a head whose run is `failure`. The summary and annotations name the rule, the path and (for SQL) the line, never the matched text.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/risk; the summary lists every finding by rule, path and line; the rules and thresholds are in docs/api/checks.md). The worker's log event `forge.risk.recorded` carries `request_id`, `project_id`, `head_sha`, `level`, `findings` and `check_run_id`.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing to change on the server. Read the reasons and fix the change (a migration is append-only: add a new one instead of editing an applied one; remove the secret and rotate it), or ask a maintainer to decide. The rules are fixed in code; a project cannot lower them yet.
